  note = {\textbf{Revised on 2026-10-12}: the comparison of the free tiers was added from section 2.1.5 of the report; the entry of 2026-09-29 weighed ``another cloud'' on cost and account grounds only.},

  decision = {The component is deployed on the FIB Virtech VM that the course offers: 4 GB of memory, 20 GB of disk, CPU only, free for one semester.
Every target in the requirements is written for this machine.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item The free tiers of AWS and GCP: 1 GB and 0.6 GB of memory do not hold an API container, Prometheus, Grafana, and a scheduled drift job.
\item Okteto or Azure: 3 GB, and 1 to 4 GB depending on the instance, so neither has more memory than the FIB machine.
\item A paid cloud or a free ARM tier: tied to a private account with payment details, and an ARM tier would need multi-architecture images.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Memory decided the choice, together with the fact that the course provides the machine.
4 GB is enough with the budgets of NFR-04: the API container stays below 1 GB, the drift job runs in its own container, and metrics and logs are capped.
The machine is a single unattended host without redundancy, which EDN-10 accounts for.},
